limitations: These are dated observations across separate read windows, not an atomic transaction or a current status feed.

The original Backlog/no-assignee initialization remains in docs/PUBLICATION.json. Subsequent completion and active work are preserved; this readback does not reset statuses or infer owners from proposed roles.
Field database IDs, UI IDs, option IDs, Project node ID and native issue node IDs are distinguished. Project content-item node IDs were not observed and are not claimed.

Contextual link preservation compares all 640 baseline reference instances with public issue Markdown links. It does not require bodies, comments, timestamps or added evidence links to remain byte-identical.

The configuration readback made no persistent Project, issue, assignee or relationship changes. The separate LB-01.03 acceptance occurred after the membership capture and is recorded as a subsequent native-state change.

This verifies configured Project metadata and actual recorded relationships. It does not certify source permissions, hosted runtime operation, native device acceptance, a live public service or completion of other work packages.
